title: tedious 20.x is not instrumented
summary: Flagged by Penelope, our upstream tracker. tedious 20 was released, but our orchestrion config for tedious only covers `>=1.11.0 <20`, so no db spans are created for tedious 20.x. The only breaking change in tedious 20 is that it requires Node 22 or newer. The `Connection` methods and fields we instrument are unchanged, so the range can be widened to `<21`.
